name: Mitsubishi Materials
business_summary: Mitsubishi Materials Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in smelting and sale of copper, gold, silver, lead, tin, palladium, and other metals. The company also offers resources circulation; manufactures and sells copper and copper alloy products; and tungsten. In addition, it is involved in the manufacture and sale of cemented carbide products and related metalworking solutions, and advanced products; geothermal, hydroelectric, and solar power generation; and investment in and participation in mining projects. Further, the company recovers and recycles valuable metals from discarded home appliances and automobile products; offers copper alloy products; and electronic materials and components for semiconductors, automotive applications (xEVs), healthcare, and electronic devices. Additionally, it engages in geothermal, hydroelectric, and solar energy business; and engineering, maintenance, industrial machinery and equipment, and resource and environmental consulting. It has operations in Japan, America, Europe, Asia, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company was founded in 1871 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
